messages:
olivia: Hey team, hitting a weird combo on the quickstart.
olivia: curl https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/firstcall -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -> x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
olivia: When I bypass TLS the response body is {"error":"workspace_pending_billing","message":"workspace needs billing setup"} even though I added a card in the Console.
samir: Two separate issues commonly: corporate proxy cert vs workspace state. First run `curl -v` to capture the server cert chain, and run the whoami endpoint to confirm which org the token maps to.

olivia: curl -v output snippet: 
```
* TLSv1.2 (IN), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLSv1.2 (IN), TLS handshake, Server hello (2)
* subject: CN=corp-proxy.internal
* issuer: CN=Corp Internal CA
* SSL certificate problem: self signed certificate in certificate chain
```

olivia: whoami returned: {"org_id": "org_personal_7", "email": "olivia@home.test"} but Console selected org is org_team_42. Oops I copied the wrong token.
jake: Yep that explains the billing body — token is valid but points to a different org that is pending billing. For the TLS issue, this is clearly a corporate MITM proxy using an internal CA. Options: add the corp CA to OS trust store, set REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE (python) or NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS (node), or run the quickstart in a container image that already trusts the CA.

samir: Example: `export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/path/to/corp-ca.pem` or `export NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=/path/to/corp-ca.pem`. For ephemeral debugging you can use `curl --cacert /path/to/corp-ca.pem` but avoid `--insecure`.

olivia: Switched to the correct org token and used REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE. Quickstart completed successfully. Thanks!

infra-bot: deploy-bot: CI job ci/quickstart-run failed for olivia at 2160001800 due to TLS error; auto-retried once.
devex-bot: Flagging a docs triage item: add a short "whoami" verification step to quickstart and a troubleshooting note for corporate proxies + wrong-token/org mismatch. Consider surfacing a clearer error when the token org doesn't match the dashboard selected org.
ajohnson: Agreed. Small UX ideas: 1) add whoami as first command in quickstart, 2) SDKs issue a clear warning if whoami.org_id != env/dashboard org (link to billing docs), 3) quickstart doc snippet showing REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE / NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS.
olivia: I'll open a tiny GH issue and PR a doc patch with the whoami-first snippet and proxy troubleshooting blurb. Tagging @samir for review. Big thanks :raised_hands:
